background-image.raw:
linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-n0) 3%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-neutral-n0) 3%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px)
background-image.resolved:
linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, #FFFFFF 3%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, #FFFFFF 3%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px)

transition.raw:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), border-color 160ms ease
transition.resolved:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), border-color 160ms ease

transition.raw: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast)
transition.resolved: border-color 150ms ease-in-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-in-out, background-color 150ms ease-in-out

font-family.raw: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
font-family.resolved: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
